name: xorr
description: XORR - short-dated range tickets that die when the block does. Monad Metropolis.

scripts.parity: cd packages/contracts && forge test --match-contract ParityDump -vv && pnpm --filter @xorr/sdk parity
scripts.deploy:local: cd packages/contracts && forge script script/Deploy.s.sol:Deploy --broadcast --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8545
scripts.remark: cd packages/contracts && forge script script/Remark.s.sol:Remark --broadcast --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8545
scripts.check: pnpm check:chain && pnpm check:kuru && pnpm check:edge
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @xorr/sdk exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @xorr/web exec tsc --noEmit
